text: We're underway at the centre circle.
Robodinho radios he's going for it!
Robodinho bursts straight through the middle! There's nobody between him and the net, a glorious early opening for Synthetic Athletic!
Zidroid charges down the right channel.
He flashes it just wide of the post from close range! Inches away from an opener for Real Machina.
Griezmatronn radios: "nudging it free!"
GOAL! CR-7000 pounces at point-blank range to make it one-nil to Real Machina!
CR-7000 has taken a tumble in the centre circle! Gyros recalibrating, and he's already working his way back onto his feet.
GOAL! CR-7000 strikes again from three metres out! Real Machina double their advantage, making it two-nil!
Zidroid advances into midfield.
"Lining up the shot," crackles Zidroid over the radio from the halfway line. Ambition in the white shirts!
GOAL! Zidroid buries it right on the goal line! Real Machina are running riot, three-nil!
Zidroid breaks clean through again from midfield with nobody in his path!
GOAL! Zidroid slides it home right at the goal mouth! It's four-nil to Real Machina, absolutely ruthless!
GOAL! A quickfire hat-trick for Zidroid, tapping in from point-blank range! Five-nil to Real Machina now!
Robodinho powers up the right flank.
GOAL! Robodinho pulls one back right on the goal line! Synthetic Athletic are on the board, five-one!
CR-7000 marches straight through the middle, taking Real Machina deep into the final third.
Flashed just wide of the mark!
GOAL! CR-7000 snatches it back and finishes from two metres out! Real Machina lead six-one!
Zidroid loses his footing out on the left channel and hits the deck, but self-righting protocols are already kicking in.
GOAL! Robodinho pounces right in front of the net! Synthetic Athletic cut the deficit to six-two!
Griezmatronn takes a spill in the final third, struggling for balance.
It whistles just past the post from deep in their own half!
The corner push-panel punches the ball back out.
CR-7000 radios: "working it free from the wall."
GOAL! It's an own goal! CR-7000 inadvertently turns it into his own net, gifting Synthetic Athletic a route back at six-three!
Griezmatronn is clean through down the right touchline!
GOAL! Griezmatronn finishes clinically from two metres out! Synthetic Athletic are mounting a comeback, six-four now!
Zidroid drives right to the line!
GOAL! Zidroid restores order right at the goal mouth! Seven-four to Real Machina!
Real Machina piling on the pressure.
"Clearing the corner," comes the urgent radio call from Griezmatronn.
That's the whistle for half-time! A breathless opening period sees Real Machina leading Synthetic Athletic seven goals to four.
Powered panel launches it back out.
Robodinho radios: "Got it!"
Synthetic Athletic are hemming Real Machina into their own third here.
GOAL! Robodinho converts from two metres! Synthetic Athletic strike early in the second half to make it seven-five!
Robodinho is clear on goal in the final third!
He's sliced it wide of the open mouth! A massive let-off for Real Machina as that effort drifts away.
Griezmatronn storms right up the middle.
GOAL! Griezmatronn taps it in from point-blank range! It's seven-six, and Synthetic Athletic are breathing right down their necks!
The corner panel fires the ball sharply back off the right touchline.
Griezmatronn radios "clearing it" as Synthetic Athletic desperately try to relieve the pressure from their own third.
The push-panel blasts it back out.
Oh, down goes Robodinho on the left flank! Overbalanced under no challenge whatsoever, but his servos are already firing to get him upright.
Zidroid surges towards the goal mouth!
GOAL! Zidroid tucks it away from two metres out! Real Machina breathe easier at eight-six!
Griezmatronn bursts completely through the midfield, unattended and with the goal at his mercy!
Synthetic Athletic are throwing everything forward, suffocating Real Machina in their own defensive third.
Griezmatronn radios: "Prying it loose!"
GOAL! Robodinho turns it in right on the line! It's eight-seven, this contest refuses to die!
Robodinho grinds his way forward through the middle, battling out toward the touchline with time ticking away.
GOAL! Unbelievable scenes, Robodinho lashes it in from two metres! Synthetic Athletic have leveled it at eight-eight!
Full time, it finishes eight-eight; what an astonishing comeback from Synthetic Athletic.
